title: Highmoor Rising Again
author: Lena Halloran
blurb: Edmund Reyes, a hedge-witch's runaway apprentice, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
